title: The Tan Hat
lines: Tom and Mom sit on the mat.
The dog digs and digs in the mud.
"Look at him dig," said Tom. He digs up a tan hat!
"It is a hat, Mom," said Tom.
Tom pats the dog on his hip.
Mom gets a rag and rubs the hat.
The hat is wet but it fits. Mom has the hat on.
"You are a fun dog," said Tom.
The dog wags and hops up at Mom.
